title: 第六千三百一十五章 纷纷逃跑第六千三百一十四章 邪魔联手
content_zh:
何楚楚也是开口问道，她眼神坚定，只要叶枫点头，她立刻就会出手相助，哪怕如今的她还不够强大。
“没必要。”
叶枫自信一笑，看着已经站在一起的远古邪龙和心魔。
“真是出乎我的预料，心魔和宿主联手，非常有趣。”
叶枫笑了笑，接着说道：“但你们两个都是垃圾，联手，也只是一坨垃圾而已。”
“放肆！”
远古邪龙勃然大怒，从古至今，谁敢如此轻视他。
“狂妄，你算什么，也敢叫嚣！”
心魔更是暴怒，它可是心魔，世间修士最畏惧的存在，竟然被人瞧不起，无法忍受！
“灭世邪枪！”
远古邪龙爆喝一声，体内邪气喷涌而出，他的灵气几乎是无穷无尽，凝聚出一根遮天蔽日的长枪，仿佛要将整个世界都洞穿。
心魔更加夸张，双手一挥，天地开始崩碎，破碎的天地残片开始组合，形成一个巨大的鼎，从天空镇压而下砸向叶枫。
“在心魔幻境之中，你们的任何手段都可笑至极。”
叶枫淡然开口，他双眼微微亮光，身后陡然亮起璀璨光芒，只见一颗庞然神阳从叶枫身后冉冉升起，无尽热量席卷而出。
长枪消融，巨鼎蒸发，就连远古邪龙和心魔的身躯都开始快速融化。
“不，不，此人的精神力量太过可怕，不能和他在心魔幻境中硬碰硬！”
远古邪龙满脸惊恐，连连惊呼。
心魔也是目露骇然，二话不说，立刻将幻境散去。
一时间，叶枫等人全都回归外界，远古邪龙第一时间后退，拉开和叶枫之间的距离，他没有本体，只有魂魄，还是比较畏惧叶枫的。
而心魔则是冲向距离最近之人，恰好是鼎尊王。

“嗯？”
鼎尊王刚好在问心天幕中击败自己的心魔，意识恢复，便见又一只心魔冲向自己，不禁面色微变。
“怎么回事，还有心魔？”
鼎尊王错愕，他通过心魔考验，那么接下来再多的心魔，也无法影响他的意识了。
“不对，他通过考验了。”
心魔冲到鼎尊王跟前时，也是发现不对劲，它选错对象了，连忙转身就跑。
可就在这时，鼎尊王却是一把抓住心魔，还主动将它引入体内。
“别走，助我一臂之力，杀了那个杂碎！”
鼎尊王咬牙切齿的开口，他双眼狠厉的看着叶枫，他之所以主动让心魔进入体内，就是因为看到了叶枫，这个让他恨之入骨的人。
“还有这种好事？”
心魔欣喜不已，它感应到鼎尊王对叶枫的滔天恨意，立刻入主鼎尊王识海，并开口道：“我会付出全力助你击杀此人！”
“好！”
鼎尊王狞笑一声，他感受到心魔的力量在体内流淌，这股力量还在他的体外构建出一副布满尖刺，魔气浩荡的诡异铠甲，这是心魔之铠，由心魔的精神力量凝聚，却蕴含着防御物理伤害的能力，并且任何攻击落在心魔之铠上，这幅铠甲还能够将攻击转化而精神力量，反弹给攻击者。
“哈哈哈哈，天助我也！”
远古邪龙看到这一幕，也是兴奋大笑，原本他心中没底，叶枫在心魔幻境中的表现太可怕了，他担心回归现实也不是叶枫对手。
content_en:
He Chuchu also asked, her eyes firm, as long as Ye Feng nodded, she would immediately help, even if she is not strong enough now.
"No need."
Ye Feng smiled confidently and looked at the ancient evil dragon and the inner demon who were already standing together.
"It's really beyond my expectation. The inner demon and the host join forces, which is very interesting."
Ye Feng smiled and then said: "But you two are both rubbish. If you join forces, you are just a piece of rubbish."
"Presumptuous!"
The ancient evil dragon was furious. From ancient times to the present, who would dare to despise him like this.
"Arrogant, who do you think you are? How dare you make such a noise!"
The inner demon is even more furious. It is the inner demon, the most feared existence among monks in the world, and it is unbearable to be looked down upon by others!
"The evil gun that destroys the world!"
The ancient evil dragon roared loudly, and the evil energy from his body spurted out. His spiritual energy was almost endless, and he condensed a spear that could cover the sky and the sun, as if it was going to penetrate the entire world.
The inner demon became even more exaggerated. With a wave of his hands, the world began to collapse, and the broken pieces of the world began to combine to form a huge cauldron, which suppressed from the sky and hit Ye Feng.
"In the inner demon world, any of your methods are ridiculous."
Ye Feng spoke calmly, his eyes shone slightly, and a bright light suddenly lit up behind him. He saw a huge divine sun rising slowly from behind Ye Feng, and endless heat swept out.
The spear melted, the giant cauldron evaporated, and even the bodies of the ancient evil dragon and the inner demon began to melt rapidly.
"No, no, this person's spiritual power is too terrifying. We cannot confront him head-on in the inner demon world!"
The ancient evil dragon's face was full of horror and he exclaimed repeatedly.
The inner demon also looked horrified, and immediately dispersed the illusion without saying a word.
For a moment, Ye Feng and others all returned to the outside world. The ancient evil dragon retreated immediately, widening the distance between it and Ye Feng. He had no body, only a soul, and was quite afraid of Ye Feng.
The inner demon rushed towards the nearest person, who happened to be Lord Ding.
"Huh?"
King Ding Zun just defeated his inner demon in the Heavenly Curtain of Asking Hearts. When he regained consciousness, he saw another inner demon rushing towards him, and his expression changed slightly.
"What's going on? Are there still inner demons?"
King Ding Zun was astonished. He had passed the inner demon test, so no amount of inner demons in the future would be able to affect his consciousness.
"No, he passed the test."
When the inner demon rushed to King Ding Zun, he also realized that something was wrong. It had chosen the wrong target and quickly turned around and ran away.
But at this moment, King Dingzun grabbed the inner demon and took the initiative to introduce it into his body.
"Don't leave, give me a helping hand and kill that bastard!"
King Dingzun gritted his teeth and looked at Ye Feng fiercely. The reason why he took the initiative to let his inner demons enter his body was because he saw Ye Feng, the person he hated so much.
"Is there such a good thing?"
The inner demon was overjoyed. It sensed King Ding Zun's overwhelming hatred for Ye Feng, and immediately entered King Ding Zun's consciousness and said, "I will give my best to help you kill this person!"
"Okay!"
King Dingzun laughed ferociously. He felt the power of the inner demon flowing in his body. This power also built a strange armor outside his body that was covered with spikes and filled with demonic energy. This was the armor of the inner demon, condensed by the spiritual power of the inner demon, but it contained the ability to defend against physical damage. Moreover, if any attack fell on the inner demon's armor, this armor could also convert the attack into spiritual power and bounce it back to the attacker.
"Hahahaha, God help me!"
When the ancient evil dragon saw this scene, he also laughed excitedly. He had no idea at first. Ye Feng's performance in the inner demon illusion was too terrible. He was worried that he would not be able to match Ye Feng when he returned to reality.
